description: Other Gemini metrics (session.count, api.request.count, tool.call.count, lines.changed with a type attribute, a look-alike name, gemini_cli.token.usage as a Gauge, the GenAI semconv gen_ai.client.token.usage histogram, a latency histogram) are ignored; only the gemini_cli.token.usage Sum contributes.
contract: ADR-0016 §3 Parser ("from metrics, only gemini_cli.token.usage Sum points are read"); SPRINT-05b A2; Gemini telemetry doc Metrics (custom metrics, GenAI semantic convention); ADR-0016 Changes 2026-10-29 (S5b review V1) R5 (estimated: false, exact token counts) and R6 (cost only for auth_type vertex-ai / gemini-api-key)
